frase_gancho.texto: Hunters who followed the mammoths into a new continent.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: This hall tells how the first human groups reached the Americas. They were bands of hunters and gatherers who moved along with the great animals they followed. During the Ice Ages the sea level dropped, and a land bridge appeared between Siberia and Alaska. Here you will see a mammoth hunted at Santa Isabel Iztapan, a bone worked by human hands, and projectile points made for big-game hunting. Further on, the story takes a turn: those peoples learned to cultivate plants, and with them came the first villages.
